documents.text:
The programme page identifies its offering as Generation AI: AI Startups 101.
The programme overview describes an eight-week course.
The FAQ says eligible founders can attend the programme free of charge.
The eligibility FAQ requires participants to be based in Victoria with a permanent address there.
For applicants with an existing startup, the FAQ requires its ABN registration within the last twelve months.
The FAQ states that programme participation does not provide funding.
The FAQ states that programme participation does not require equity.
